name: conductor
description_en: Conductor is an event driven agentic workflow engine providing durable and highly resilient execution engine for applications and AI Agents
readme_excerpt: Conductor - Durable Execution for Workflows and Agents Build agents that adapt. Run graphs that endure. Conductor is an open-source durable execution platform for microservices, AI agents, and adaptive workflow graphs. It turns runtime choices—loops, branching, fan-out, tool calls, approvals, retries, and cancellation—into durable, inspectable execution. It originated at Netflix and is actively maintained by Orkes and the community. Get Running in 60 Seconds Prerequisites: Node.js v16+ and Java…
